title: AI's Creative Leap: Instruct, Don't Operate Tools #shorts
description: We're shifting from operating AI tools to instructing them. Text to image, text to video, editing by description, summarizing audio, generating layouts – this is the dawn of multi-modal AI. #AIMultimodal #AIRevolution #FutureTech #ArtificialIntelligence
